description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan with haste.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Titan until the token Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Titan.
The token Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
